title: Managers with the most Champions League wins
brief: Name the ten managers who have won the most Champions League games since 1992/93. Wins after extra time count; shoot-outs count as draws.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards; in 1992/93 and 1993/94 the first and second rounds count; games a manager missed through a touchline ban still count for him

notes.Ottmar Hitzfeld: Ottmar Hitzfeld is just outside with 47.

checks: Each manager's games come from Transfermarkt and are matched one by one to UEFA's results, which give the score after extra time and the shoot-out separately (Transfermarkt adds shoot-out kicks to its scores, so its colours were not used). UEFA line-ups confirm the manager for most games from 2008/09. Leaving out the few games under touchline bans would not change who is in the ten (Klopp and Van Gaal could swap seventh and eighth).
